name: Olympic Club (cypress-lined fog belt and Pacific bluffs)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. The Olympic Club, San Francisco: the Lake's narrow, tree-lined corridors of Monterey cypress, pine and eucalyptus on the slope down to Lake Merced, and the Cliffs on the bluffs above the Pacific. A deep, saturated poa/rye green with darker rough (F0-F2), bright off-white sand, the blue-grey Pacific (W0-W2), weathered grey-tan bluffs (K3-K4). Trees in assets-src/trees_olympic_club.py. The course chat's design, 2026-11-13. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
